kjv: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

lines.say: and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life. Psalm forty two, verse eight.
lines.big: and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

lines.say: Mercy in the daytime, a song in the night. He covers you both ways.

lines.say: Lord, thank you for your song in the night. Keep me tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
